acceptance_criteria.criterion: Each node defines a schema with node_id, display_name, category="json", description, three inputs (json_object optional, value typed, key with default "key"), and three outputs (JSON_OBJECT, VALUE, KEY).
When json_object is not connected (None), each node creates a new empty dict.
When json_object is connected, each node deep-copies it before modification (does not mutate upstream output).
Each node calls _set_nested_key() to insert the value, supporting dot-notation keys.
VALUE output passes through the exact input value unchanged.
KEY output passes through the exact key string unchanged.
Each node returns io.NodeOutput(obj, value, key).
